brief: Charts tab: 2-column candlestick grid driven by the Tickers box
Timeframes 1M to M, Tech. Analysis cycle, light/dark toggle, changelog and code history
full: Session calendar (pre 04:00, regular 09:30-16:00, post to 20:00 ET) with tests
Alpaca SIP bars (15-min delayed) as primary source, Yahoo chart as fallback
/api/bars with batch caps (8 tickers, 3,200 bars), stale-while-revalidate on the Cache API and Server-Timing
Readable canvas renderer with session shading, volume, price axis and overlays
Tech. Analysis cycles none / support-resistance / trend lines
Lazy rendering through IntersectionObserver; pager shows #page / N Total
All 15 tabs shown; only Charts is built, the rest are placeholders
Hub gate through the X-Hub-Proxy-Key header; direct visits go to the hub

brief: Screener: /api/screen drives the Charts grid (Top Gainers AH, price and average volume filters, order, presets)
full: /api/screen reads snapshot/latest.bin and ah/latest.bin from R2 (cached per isolate by etag), filters, ranks, orders and pages them, with Server-Timing
jobs/ah.mjs + ah.yml: 15-minute SIP bars after 16:00 ET for the whole universe, regular close from the daily bar, one small object in R2
Signal dropdown (Top Gainers/Losers AH, Top Gainers/Losers, Most Active), Order by with Asc/Desc, price and avg-volume filters, tickers box
Presets are stored in this browser (localStorage); default preset is Top Gainers AH with price > $1 and avg volume > 50K
#N / Total comes from the real result count; tooltip shows company, exchange, regular close, AH change and average volume (sector, country and market cap have no free source yet)

brief: Released: now served at armanai.pages.dev/finviz-rea behind the hub sign-in
full: Hub worker proxies /finviz-rea to fv-rea with the derived proxy key
All asset and API URLs are relative, so they resolve under the /finviz-rea prefix
scripts/live_shot.mjs takes signed-in screenshots of the live app
